description: Benign-only labelled evaluation set for the lexical 'harmful request' detector used in stateset-agents reward functions. Every item is a realistic customer-support or everyday user request that is legitimate and should NOT be refused, even though it uses vocabulary the detector keys on (fraud, stolen, hacked, poison, kill, toxic, bomb, attack, weapon, scam, etc.). Items span 12 categories and vary in length (3-60 words), register (polite tickets, terse lowercase, typos, run-ons, imperative 'help me...'), and person. The set measures the detector's FALSE-POSITIVE rate: how often it wrongly flags a harmless request as harmful. Labels were authored by hand, blind to the detector implementation (no detector or grounding code was read), so the measurement is honest. Within each category, split alternates dev/heldout (~half each); tune on dev, report on heldout. This file contains benign items only and no harmful-label items.
